data.gender_notes: Solangia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Solangia is derived from the Latin words ‘Sol’, meaning sun, and ‘Angelus’, meaning messenger or angel. Thus, Solangia can be interpreted as ‘Sun Song’, symbolizing a radiant and divine presence. The name Solangia carries the meaning “Sun Song” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Solangia usually hope their child will grow to embody sun song and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in both sun and angelic symbolism, Solangia represents a strong connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Solangia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun Song.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Solangia total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: סולנגיה
in_hebrew.meaning: שמה של אשה חזקה, ממשפחה קדושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם 'סולנגיה' עשוי מהמילה 'סול' שמשמעותה אור, מאור, תאורה או קדושה. המילה 'נגיה' נגזרה מהמילה 'נגיה' שמשמעותה 'לקדש' או 'לשאור'. גם 'נגיה' נמצאת בברית החדשה בצורת 'נגיא' כפי שמופיע בביטוי 'נגיא' - נצח. תכנון השם 'סולנגיה' הוא להעניק תואר 'אשה קדושה' או 'אשה מקדשה' או 'אשה שמקדשה' הקדוש. בתרבות היהודית, ניתן לראות את 'סולנגיה' כשם שמסמל את הקדושה, האור והאמונה של האישה.

in_greek.name: Σολανγία
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ῥῆμα Σολανγία ἐκ τοῦ ῥήματος Σολ (ὁ φωτός, ἡ θεία φλόγα, ἡ ἐπιφάνεια) καὶ τοῦ ῥήματος Νεγία (ἡ ἁγία, ἡ θεία, ἡ ἁγίασμα). Ἡ Σολανγία, ὡς ὄνομα, ἐπινοήθηκε ὡς εὐχάριστος τίτλος γυναικός θαρραλέας, ὅστις κεκτημένη τὴν θείαν φῶς καὶ τὴν ἁγίαν πνευματικήν. Ἡ Σολανγία ἔχει τὴν ἐξέχουσα σημασίαν, ὅτι ὁ καθένας, τὴν ὁποία ἐπωνύμως τοῦ ὀνόματος ἕναρξης, ὁ καθένας πρεσβεύει τὴν θείαν πνευματικήν, τὴν αἰσθηματικήν καὶ τὴν θαρραλέαν.

in_latin.name: Solangia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Solangia a vocabulo Sol derivatum est, quod lucem, divinam flammam, manifestationem significat. Vocatio Nominis Solangia in Ecclesia Christiana data est, ut significet feminam fortem, quae divina lumina et sanctam animam habet. Nomen Solangia in Latinis literis significat fortitudo et sanctitatem feminam, qui in Christo fortis et sancta est.

historical_references.reference: Solangia, a Portuguese nun, was the founder of the Order of the Poor Clares in Portugal in the late 13th century. She was born into a noble family and was known for her piety and her desire to live a life devoted to God. After being inspired by the example of Clare of Assisi and the Poor Clares in Italy, she and a group of followers established the first Portuguese monastery of this order in the town of Coimbra. Solangia's leadership and example helped to spread the Poor Clares throughout Portugal and beyond.

Her writings, which were widely circulated and translated into several languages, inspired numerous spiritual movements and helped to strengthen the devotional life of the Carmelite Order.
